description: Caching for Go services that run as many processes: GetOrLoad with stale data, locks, tags, rate limits, circuit breakers and an HTTP middleware, over memory or Redis.
rules: Create one *gashe.Cache per backend with gashe.New, share it, and call Shutdown before closing the backend.
Load data through gashe.For with a Policy and Cached.GetOrLoad; Policy.TTL.For is required unless a window of Policy.Stale is set.
Keys of the application must not start with "__": the cache keeps its own keys there.
Use Policy.Stampede.LockFor when many processes load the same cold key, and Policy.Stale.IfError when a stale result is better than an error.
Check errors with errors.Is: ErrNotFound, ErrOverloaded, ErrCircuitOpen and ErrRateLimited.
